primary.title: The Foundations of Leninism
primary.author: Joseph Stalin
primary.rationale: A foundational text outlining Stalin's interpretation of Marxist-Leninist theory, widely disseminated and influential.

primary.title: Report to the Eighteenth Congress of the C.P.S.U.(B.) on the Work of the Central Committee
primary.author: Joseph Stalin
primary.rationale: A key speech delivered at a major party congress, detailing the party's policies and achievements from Stalin's perspective.

primary.title: On the Great Patriotic War of the Soviet Union
primary.author: Joseph Stalin
primary.rationale: A collection of speeches and orders during World War II, offering direct insight into his wartime leadership and propaganda.

secondary.title: Stalin: Paradoxes of Power, 1878-1953
secondary.author: Stephen Kotkin
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and highly regarded biography that offers deep analysis of Stalin's life, ideology, and rule.

secondary.title: The Soviet Tragedy: A History of Stalinism
secondary.author: Martin Malia
secondary.rationale: A critical examination of the historical trajectory and ideological underpinnings of Stalinism.

secondary.title: Stalin: New Biography of a Dictator
secondary.author: Robert Service
secondary.rationale: Another major biographical work that provides a detailed account of Stalin's rise to power and his dictatorial regime.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are often found in collections of speeches, writings, and official documents. Secondary sources are selected for their scholarly reputation and comprehensive coverage.
